name: smwmusic-umamusume-pretty-derby-umapyoi-legend-star-mix
title: Umamusume: Pretty Derby - Umapyoi Legend (Star-mix)
description:
Did a short arrangement of Umapyoi Legend / Umapyoi Densetsu from Umamusume: Pretty Derby. There's a lack of Uma-rep on this site, so let's change that!!!

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. G Major (Original Pitch) ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. F Major (Enhance Menu Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Enables the Intro (INTRO Enabled)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. Skips the Intro (INTRO Skipped)
